_comment: Copy this file to secrets.local.json (gitignored) and fill in real values. pff_token is only for the optional PFF grades reference field. poll_export_url is the power-poll ballot's private export link (the 'Pipeline export' row in the poll's 'Links (private)' tab, see poll/SETUP.md); weekly_report.py reads ballots from it for week 3 on.
